76955.subject: Important Changes to Bybit EU´s Trading Fees
76955.body:
Anti-phishing Code 

Dear User,

We are writing to inform you about upcoming changes to Bybit EU GmbH´s (“Bybit EU”) Trading Fees.

We are unifying our Spot and Spot Margin Trading Fees to create a more streamlined and straightforward trading experience. Taking effect on *October 5, 2026, at 12:00 CET* , Bybit EU will officially transition away from Maker and Taker Fees into a single, unified Trading Fee for all Spot and Spot Margin transactions. The unified Trading Fee will be set at the current Taker rate, meaning the previous Maker fee structures will be officially retired for all users after the effective date.

Below is an overview of how the Unified Trading Fee will apply to you, based on your user tier and trading volume:

The changes regarding Spot and Spot Margin Trading Fees will become applicable to you on *October 5, 2026 12:00 CET.*

If you agree with these changes, no further action is required on your part.

If you do not agree with the new Trading Fees, you have the right to explicitly object to them at any time before *October 5, 2026 12:00 CET* by contacting our support team via the channels referred below. Please note that if you choose to object, we will be unable to continue providing you with Spot and Spot Margin Trading services, and your objection will be treated as a termination of those specific services, effective *October 5, 2026 12:00 CET*. From that date, you will no longer be able to open new Spot or Spot Margin trades. Consistent with your rights, this objection has no effect on any other Bybit EU products or services. Your account will remain fully active, and you will keep unrestricted access to your funds. Additionally, you always retain the right to fully terminate your account and withdraw your funds free of any charge until *October 5, 2026 12:00 CET.*

For the avoidance of doubt, all other fees applicable on bybit.eu remain fully unchanged unless expressly stated otherwise. Comprehensive trading fee information is always available at https://url2808.noreply.bybit.eu/ls/click?upn=u001.C6Kz-2B-2FaO8o3cSL6WzsJKpCih6gfm0A3HoAbHDOwJvgOZagJEut38pw4E5rPPlTc1ZH65jDf5kYa7xeWD-2BBYw4Q-3D-3DLFFG_mTOA-2BX07kQ2Ojbv-2BRbqdnpNrlwyNnm2KPByKJ9Ex4L2vKSlOXo5b9Zs41RNvLPkr1NnXoV-2FcPdW91qcbNZhKShJen3b1jWu9lT1-2Bl2O85gXIeXX2chQgWNpU6Byok6UDDGKWAGlDtATjmuL-2Fg5aoisbmRQv-2FB-2FxK0RiMuKqLfbc7A9mcYVyB70iLNFZ8-2FQTdBylM9azzSRcQ8RzEZ0pMoZY-2FLe85wGjgVQc13WORxRnxv3TY1Ui8A4I7s7JdDHb6gnvxaPlvK7QRUPDb8NI0wUXan2TgD1jYa2fCxaPneQ4Y7bdkMtf62diSI94QyRg-2Fcp2em81-2BJKjiYoqginsxSjttiiTFubY6J7VRP8ifEBpbGJIMCN2TmhiUBMM-2BYRE7EsANibO7QuTMHX-2BiLHo0IcvM7zcw-2FUU6gokEUbtx8vTYvh6C0zC-2Ff-2BCxyWWXI46kMpy41X-2BdJtiqDgW6EHEIj5LEk0IuBARxvGVJK2mVqEEcsGpHEvZqyzaxaJFlbBB2qLOjll1tXz17oCNFkBHy7bm6iWJ46DzOjKMwdFjtKqIo9ShWWMYjCL1wqOJCvHKi7gfj-2F6zXg4TpA971ObUxumbw2hLDSeMoo4FDp40KPllEzgESq29eBArZQMOTwEQZoYV-2BAzGC8p1ePfsuEWfaxP0vQYXkdIIoEc-2BxnOd8re-2BhdD-2FeTgbvFOZfUHMJTAB4izY7w4ZD3E35qDOr26-2FkIiu0g4DWOvlaPNB4YMkICVsD5p6uVfoR4Bc9Pnz76-2BpR7VA

76952.body:
Bybit Learn

Автор: Bybit

Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/unitree-ipo-what-you-need-know-bybitexchange-gl8re?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BsTiY74zJR9KRWuoPYm6AHA%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=1WBg6KRJwzaIo1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~msenpr6u~xi-null-null&eid=fz96fz-msenpr6u-xi
  
Unitree's humanoid robots went viral for doing backflips and martial arts — and now the company behind them is going public. With China fast-tracking approval and a $6.2 billion valuation on the table, Unitree's IPO is shaping up to be one of the most-watched listings in robotics. Here's what traders need to know about the company, the opportunity and the risks. Key Takeaways: Unitree is set to IPO on Shanghai's STAR Market at a ~$6.2 billion valuation — the first humanoid AI company to list on China's A-share market. Its robots dramatically undercut Western rivals on price and it shipped over 5,500 units in 2025, far outpacing Tesla's ~150. Traders can get early exposure to UNITREEUSDT via Bybit's Pre-Market Perpetuals before the stock officially lists. What is Unitree? You've likely already seen Unitree's robots go viral on social media. Unitree (officially Yushu Technology) is a Chinese company based in Hangzhou that builds humanoid and quadruped (four-legged) robots powered by AI.  Think of Unitree as China's answer to Boston Dynamics, or even Tesla's humanoid robots. Its robots can walk, run, and even do martial arts - such demonstrations went viral globally and is now pivoting its main business toward humanoid models used in factories and research. It's a fast-growing market. Morgan Stanley estimates that China could ship out 50,000 humanoid robots this year. Why Unitree stands out 1) Unitree's robots are surprisingly cheap Unitree's biggest edge is price. Its humanoid robots can cost less than a car - dramatically undercutting Western rivals. Besides the cost, Unitree's robots are outperforming on other metrics: Its flagship H1 model carries up to 30 kg of payload at 73 kg body weight - strong hardware specs versus peers. It supplies robots to major AI and tech research institutions globally, giving it real-world training data that competitors lack. Unitree shipped over 5,500 robots in 2025, far outperforming its US peers (Tesla shipped roughly 150 units last year). 2) Unitree's IPO (initial public offering) was fast-tracked in record time Unitree formally launched its IPO on July 30, 2026 on Shanghai's STAR Market (China's version of Nasdaq for high-tech companies). The robotics firm is looking to sell at least 40 million shares to raise 4.2 billion yuan (~$620 million) at a total company valuation of roughly 42 billion yuan (~$6.2 billion).  China's regulator

Bitcoin edged slightly higher overnight from yesterday's lows,
but the broader trend remains rangebound ahead of the Senate's
August recess deadline on August 7.

That deadline is now the market's most urgent policy watch. A
bill that could reshape US crypto regulation has just days left
before it stalls until September. Meanwhile institutional
treasury moves are pulling in opposite directions.

Let's dive in.

Latest News
-----------

The Crypto Bill Has Days Left Before Senate Recess

Bernstein warned on August 3 that the CLARITY Act faces its
final window before the Senate recesses around August 7, with
Polymarket pricing year-end passage at just 31%. A failure would
likely trigger a short-term market sell-off.

Analysts expect the SEC and CFTC to accelerate rulemaking
through their joint Project Crypto initiative if the bill does
not pass.

What specific areas would regulators fast-track if the CLARITY
